haikus.haiku:
Golden crust rises
Scent drifts through warm kitchen air
Melted butter sings
Happy #NationalYorkshirePuddingDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bright thoughts rise like sun
Neurons hum in cool morning
Learning lifts the heart
Happy #NationalTrainYourBrainDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden candles glow
Soft laughter fills the bright room
Joy dances in hearts
#HappyBirthdayNipseyRussell from @ClamBakeSanta
